subject.title: fix: require decimal numeric oc-path predicates

question: Should oc-path relational predicates preserve the shipped finite-number coercion contract, or intentionally adopt a new plain-decimal-only grammar?
rationale: The patch changes documented user-visible query semantics, and source inspection cannot determine whether rejecting exponent and other coercible forms is desired product policy.

options.title: Preserve coercion
options.body: Keep the existing finite-number behavior and close or revise this PR until a concrete incompatible case warrants a narrower change.

options.title: Adopt decimal-only grammar
options.body: Approve the breaking semantic change, document the exact accepted syntax, and require compatibility tests plus live CLI proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the fix
options.body: Define and reject only specifically unwanted operand forms while retaining the rest of the documented coercion behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve coercion
recommendation.body: Keep the existing finite-number behavior and close or revise this PR until a concrete incompatible case warrants a narrower change.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest available history signal for the bundled oc-path feature and recent parser contract work.
